content:
Fine-grained access control introduces some additional complications with taking manual
snapshots. To register a snapshot repository—even if you use HTTP basic authentication for
all other purposes—you must map the manage_snapshots role to an IAM role that has
iam:PassRole permissions to assume TheSnapshotRole, as deﬁned in the section called
“Prerequisites”.
Then use that IAM role to send a signed request to the domain, as outlined in the section called
“Registering a manual snapshot repository”.
